title: Input schema for Pry Maps Lead Extractor
description: Extract local business leads from Google Maps listings: names, addresses, phones, websites and publicly listed emails in one pass. Combines the two most-demanded Apify workflows - maps data and contact enrichment - with anti-bot escalation built in.

urls.title: Maps search URLs
urls.description: Google Maps search or place URLs to extract businesses from.

include_social_links.title: Include social profiles
include_social_links.description: Collect LinkedIn/X/Facebook links from business sites.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
